title: I am Pro-Life. I Vote Pro-Choice.
description:
A deep dive into the philosophy and politics of abortion that challenges the distinction between pro-life and pro-choice.

Dr Steven Brown PhD, is Senior Lecturer in the Department of Philosophy at The Ohio State University.

Guttmacher Institute report on demographics of abortion in the US:
https://www.guttmacher.org/report/characteristics-us-abortion-patients-2014

Medium Article - Abortion Bans Don’t Work:
https://medium.com/@gidmk/abortion-bans-dont-work-2c9fff7bb025

Nikki Glaser's interview of Whitney Cummings:
https://youtu.be/7JcnMnYFKK4
